# Students Enrolled in Courses: INNER JOIN

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## Students Enrolled in Courses: INNER JOIN

To answer the dean's question, "Which students are enrolled in courses?" you can match the students table with the enrollments table, focusing only on students enrolled in at least one course.

For this, INNER JOIN is ideal because it only retrieves rows where there are matches in both tables.

```sql
1-- Join the students and enrollments tables 
2-- On the student ID column, select rows 
3-- where the ID matches in both tables.
4
5SELECT Students.name, Enrollments.course_id
6FROM Students
7INNER JOIN Enrollments
8ON Students.id = Enrollments.student_id;
```
